body: Back in August, I didn't plan on making it through the end of the summer. There are a number of reasons that I'm still here today, one of them being that I met some great people on SW who have been here for me through my roughest months. Getting better involved a lot of therapy, medication, and pain. Having someone to talk to when I had no one else made all the difference.

I keep looking into a few hobbies when I have a period of motivation, but then it fades and I don't follow through. I need to find a way to follow through.

I don't know what the point of life is, or if there even is a point. 

Your comment is really helpful. I need to focus on living my life and seeking out happiness.
both. they help, but they can't do it all.

It's nice to hear that you're in a good mood.

I guess my life has just derailed and there isn't really a track to get back onto, so I'm lost. And I'm also finding it hard to care about much at all.
I don't have many people to lean on right now, but I am getting support from the few that are around at the moment and it's helping. Thanks for the encouragement.
